# Scope of Work — Meridian Sports — Follow-up (Meeting C)

_Status: DRAFT — requires human approval before sending. Pipeline: scope-pipeline-v1_

## Requirements (with feasibility checked against product knowledge)

### REQ-001 — First, we want one more filter — by price range
- Status: **confirmed** · Priority: should-have · Feasibility: **existing_configuration**
- Feasibility note: Search filters (category/location/level) and radius search are settings under Search Settings.
- Evidence: no KB citation (offline check)
- Acceptance: Client can verify: first, we want one more filter — by price range (confirm exact test at approval).
- Client said (Sarah): “Sarah: A few things. First, we want one more filter — by price range. Customers keep asking for it. That's new, on top of category and location.”

### REQ-002 — Customers keep asking for it
- Status: **confirmed** · Priority: should-have · Feasibility: **needs_clarification**
- Feasibility note: No matching documented capability found. Absence of evidence is not evidence of absence — expert to confirm.
- Evidence: no KB citation (offline check)
- Acceptance: Client can verify: customers keep asking for it (confirm exact test at approval).
- Client said (Sarah): “Sarah: A few things. First, we want one more filter — by price range. Customers keep asking for it. That's new, on top of category and location.”

### REQ-003 — Third, on mobile we changed our mind: the search bar should sit below the header image, not above it
- Status: **confirmed** · Priority: should-have · Feasibility: **existing_with_limitation**
- Feasibility note: Themes responsive; mobile search-bar position is a Design Setting. Custom mobile layouts need dev.
- Evidence: no KB citation (offline check)
- Acceptance: Client can verify: third, on mobile we changed our mind: the search bar should sit below the header image, not above it (confirm exact test at approval).
- Client said (Sarah): “Sarah: Third, on mobile we changed our mind: the search bar should sit below the header image, not above it. Our designer mocked it up and below looks better.”

### REQ-004 — We want to launch at the end of January instead
- Status: **confirmed** · Priority: should-have · Feasibility: **needs_clarification**
- Feasibility note: Timeline statement — not a product feature; confirm as project constraint.
- Evidence: no KB citation (offline check)
- Acceptance: Client can verify: we want to launch at the end of january instead (confirm exact test at approval).
- Client said (James): “James: Also the timeline moved. Christmas is unrealistic for our team. We want to launch at the end of January instead.”

### REQ-005 — And a new idea: could members take bookings directly on their listing page?
- Status: **confirmed** · Priority: should-have · Feasibility: **potential_custom_development**
- Feasibility note: No booking calendar in documented features.
- Evidence: no KB citation (offline check)
- Acceptance: Client can verify: and a new idea: could members take bookings directly on their listing page? (confirm exact test at approval).
- Client said (Sarah): “Sarah: And a new idea: could members take bookings directly on their listing page? Like a booking calendar. I know that wasn't in the original scope — tell us what it would cost separately.”

## Explicit exclusions (from client's own words)

- Second, drop the AI search idea for now. We talked it over — no longer needed in phase one. Good standard filters first, AI later if ever.

## Open questions (do not estimate as firm work until answered)

- REQ-002: Customers keep asking for it — No matching documented capability found. Absence of evidence is not evidence of absence — expert to confirm.
- REQ-004: We want to launch at the end of January instead — Timeline statement — not a product feature; confirm as project constraint.

## Effort summary

- Low: **26 h** · Likely: **53 h** · High: **95 h**
- Ranges, not a fixed quote. `needs_clarification` items carry only a discovery spike.

## Client responsibilities
- Approve/revise this scope; confirm acceptance tests; provide test data and timely feedback.

We reviewed your requirements against the product's documented capabilities first. 2 item(s) can be delivered mainly through existing settings (faster, cheaper); 1 item(s) need custom development and are priced separately below.

- **REQ-001** First, we want one more filter — by price range (existing configuration)

- **REQ-003** Third, on mobile we changed our mind: the search bar should sit below the header image, not above it (existing with limitation)
- **REQ-004** We want to launch at the end of January instead (needs clarification)
- **REQ-005** And a new idea: could members take bookings directly on their listing page? (potential custom development)

## Effort & pricing assumptions

- Estimated effort: 26–95 hours (likely 53 h).
- Hourly rate not set: hours only. A human confirms the commercial price before this is sent.
- Items marked 'needs clarification' are quoted only as a short discovery spike until confirmed.

## What is NOT included
- Anything in the scope's exclusions, and any requirement added after approval (quoted as a change).

## Next step
- Reply approving this scope (or request changes). No work begins before approval.
